headline: US October Goods Trade Deficit Widens to $149.5 Billion
summary: The US goods trade deficit widened to $149.5 billion in October as imports rose by $21.1 billion to $365.3 billion, outpacing a $6.7 billion increase in exports.
why: International trade balances reflect macroeconomic demand trends, influencing gross domestic product calculations and currency valuations.

impacts.name: United States
impacts.why: A widening goods trade deficit indicates higher import growth relative to exports, impacting external accounts.
